scope: One proposed, source-bound local loan recovery attempt using the existing included deployment and original identities, under the exact reviewed time/CPU/memory/DUST/gross limits. This is one substantive resource vote, not execution admission or runtime/financial acceptance.
rationale: The retained deployment already succeeded and the failed private persistence has a changed, independently reviewed recovery mechanism. The runner verifies a separately admitted exact candidate and actual review references, preserves the original charged history, arms external containment before services, performs public current-state/finality checks before new private preparation, and then permits only the three remaining calls. The resource request is finite and does not fund a redeployment or automatic retry.

conditions: Execution requires a second substantive agreeing Grok resource vote on these exact proposal/command/runner hashes, followed by a separately constructed faithful admission. This vote alone does not dispatch anything.

Admission must include the exact reviewed runner/document, candidate, both source approvals and retained actual source responses, both resource votes and retained actual responses, predecessor timer, committee probe, fixed build approvals and retained original deployment/result. Preserve reviewer identities and conditions; do not treat normalized summaries as independent observations.

Run this exact script once under ordinary non-optimized Python. Do not relax any runtime gate, extend time/resources, create a replacement attempt/base, regenerate a rejected password, redeploy or retry after failure without a new decision.

All currently inspected source/build bytes must remain unchanged; the existing loader/runtime checks must fail closed if artifacts or SDK pins become stale. Runtime stopped-container/identity/headroom and public/current-state/private/wallet gates must actually pass before their dependent operations.

Retain all prior and new reservations/partial public payloads, original wallet snapshots, original private store/password/roles and container writable layers. Never refund historical deployment charges merely because it is observed again.

Monitor the bounded run and independently observe terminal launcher cgroup emptiness and all container stops. A successful timer command, inner wallet stop, or script exit is not itself proof of containment; failed or unknown cleanup remains unresolved and does not authorize retry.

Report every actual public transaction identifier and observed status, including unknown finality, under repository notification rules. Financial/proof/Preview/full-SP05/PCD acceptance must not be inferred from source approval, budget vote, three submissions or inner test results.
Keep the explicitly declared no-hard-disk-quota and unknown absolute proof-HTTP-count limitations visible in the run record.
limitations: Static/AST and read-only evidence inspection only. Operational runner was neither imported nor executed. No service/container action, live network query, wallet operation, private-file preparation or actual original secret/store read occurred.
Reviewed public build artifact bytes are compiler outputs only; no proof or runtime loader execution was performed during this resource vote.
Actual current chain/finality/committee readiness, spent-wallet exclusion, available DUST, original metadata-only store and successful private restore remain unperformed prerequisites.
Runtime timer scheduling, OS/Docker cooperation and final containment require actual observation. The runner records incomplete or failed outcomes honestly; resource bounds do not guarantee success.
Host memory/disk/container state was not queried by this reviewer; those values are mandatory checks in the exact runner before service start.
No aggregate hard disk quota or absolute SDK callback/HTTP attempt count is established. The vote accepts the stated finite CPU/memory/time envelope with those explicit limits.
